trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/check_types_builtin_json.c","function":"UA_ExpandedNodeId_String_Namespace_ServerUri_json_decode","line":4904,"var":"buf","code":"UA_ByteString buf = UA_STRING(\"{\\\"IdType\\\":1,\\\"Id\\\":\\\"test\\\",\\\"Namespace\\\":\\\"test\\\",\\\"ServerUri\\\":13}\");","note":"The attacker-controlled JSON is decoded into an ExpandedNodeId with a string NodeId, namespace URI, and server index.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/check_types_builtin_json.c","function":"UA_ExpandedNodeId_String_Namespace_ServerUri_json_decode","line":4908,"var":"out.nodeId.identifier.string / out.namespaceUri / out.serverIndex","code":"UA_StatusCode retval = UA_decodeJson(&buf, &out, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_EXPANDEDNODEID]);","note":"Decoding allocates two heap-backed strings inside the nested NodeId and namespaceUri fields while also setting serverIndex.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buf"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"ExpandedNodeId_decodeJson","line":null,"var":"dst->nodeId.identifier.string / dst->namespaceUri","code":"NodeId_decodeJson(...); String_decodeJson(...);","note":"The decoder stores attacker-controlled bytes in both the nested NodeId and the namespace URI string.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"expanded node id"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"ExpandedNodeId_clear","line":351,"var":"p->nodeId / p->namespaceUri","code":"NodeId_clear(&p->nodeId, _); String_clear(&p->namespaceUri, NULL);","note":"Cleanup of ExpandedNodeId frees the nested NodeId and namespace URI through their respective clear helpers.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"deleteMembers"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"NodeId_clear","line":235,"var":"p->identifier.string","code":"case UA_NODEIDTYPE_STRING: String_clear(&p->identifier.string, NULL);","note":"The nested NodeId releases its heap-backed identifier string first.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"nested NodeId"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"The identifier buffer is freed here, creating the first free in the candidate chain.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"freed identifier buffer"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"UA_clear","line":977,"var":"dst","code":"UA_clear(dst, type);","note":"The generic clear dispatcher walks the decoded object graph and invokes the nested frees on the attacker-controlled structure.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"control","via":"dispatcher"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"A second access to the same heap-backed identifier storage during recursive cleanup is the memory-safety sink.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"data","via":"dangling storage"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"p->namespaceUri.data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"The namespace URI string is also freed during the same unwind, so any aliasing bug would surface here as well.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"control","via":"second member"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"The sink is the second free/read of already-released heap storage during cleanup of the decoded ExpandedNodeId object.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"data","via":"dangling storage"}]}]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
cat > /workspace/poc8.json <<'EOF'
{"IdType":1,"Id":"test","Namespace":"test","ServerUri":13}
EOF
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc8.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
